mission_07: Knowledge Graph Embeddings represent entities and relations as vectors in a continuous space, enabling link prediction and knowledge graph completion. TransE models relations as translations: for a valid triplet (head, relation, tail), the embedding h + r should be close to t. The score is the L2 distance ||h + r - t||, with lower scores indicating more plausible triplets. Training uses margin-based ranking loss: positive triplets should score lower than corrupted (negative) triplets by at least a margin. In this mission, you implement TransE with entity and relation embeddings, translation-based scoring, negative sampling by corrupting heads or tails, margin-based ranking loss with gradient updates, tail entity prediction, and evaluation using Mean Rank and Hits@10 metrics.
